feeds.title: The Dancing Word Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Dancing Word. I offer resources, images, classes, prayer videos, and publications to foster connections between body and spirit, tradition and creativity, scripture, dance and life.

feeds.title: Praise Dance Your Ministry Blog
feeds.description: Dance ministry blog that supplies tips and advice on enhancing your personal and corporate praise-dance and worship-arts ministry. His Hem Ministry, LLC, is about our personal testimony and takes its name from Matthew 9:20 and Luke 6:19, Biblical scriptures that reference Jesus' power in healing - from a simple touch from the edges of his garment.

feeds.title: Being Salt Blog
feeds.description: A blog for all things dancing with the Spirit. Teachings, how-to articles, guest writers, and resources - to help you grow your dance-gift and become aligned with God in pursuit and purpose. I'm Tehillah. I help trained and non-trained dancers develop intimate connection with God through coaching and movement devotionals so they can move past pretense + performance and get to know the signature dance-voice God has put inside of them to impact the world.

feeds.title: UC Grace Blog » Christian Dance
feeds.description: UC Grace seeks to build deeper relationships with God through dance and movement. Pioneering a connective way to bring dance and faith together. Learn more about Christian dance with our articles on faith, dancing and more!
